1879060547.Skill_Desc: Your Fervour is instantly increased as well as some additional fervour over time.

1879060803.Skill_Desc: Unstable earth deals Fire damage to several enemies.

1879064387.Skill_Desc: Returns you and your Fellowship to Esteldín.\n\nThis skill is easily interrupted.

1879073219.Skill_Desc: Your companion lets out a terrifying bellow and forces many enemies to target them.

1879089859.Skill_Desc: Returns you and your Fellowship to Michel Delving in the Shire.\n\nThis skill is easily interrupted.

1879093059.Skill_Desc: Nothing can escape your searching gaze. So long as it is a worm.

1879136963.Skill_Desc: You quickly overwhelm your opponent, reducing their chance to parry or block your blows.\nWhile you have the upper hand, Blade Toss is more likely to knock down your opponents.

1879212099.Skill_Desc: You don't know what D.R.A.G.O.N. stands for, so you best try this on someone else. Though there is some fine print: 'Made with 10% real dragons'.

1879213891.Skill_Desc: Your Fellowship strikes at Draigoch's front right leg, reducing its ability to resist damage.

1879233859.Skill_Desc: The Destrier is a heavily armoured War-steed. Stalwart and imposing, The Destrier is bred for battle. The least agile and slowest of the war-steeds trades speed and maneuverability.

1879242307.Skill_Desc: You use your sword and staff to deliver a powerful strike to the enemy before you.\n\nWhen your companion has Flanked the enemy, this skill will restore a small amount of power.

1879244867.Skill_Desc: The ultimate expression of tactical horsemanship, this is a dangerous strike on its own; when enhanced by the Riddermark Discipline your ranged damage is increased.

1879245635.Skill_Desc:
<rgb=#66fff>Mounted Discipline</rgb>

Mounted Disciplines are used to alter the attitude and tactics used by your War-steed in Mounted Combat

<rgb=#66ffff>Riddermark</rgb>

The Riddermark Discipline focuses on the chilling and enervating runes of storm. When carved and etched correctly you can manipulate the actions of your enemies.

1879267139.Skill_Desc: You throw a punch at your enemy.

1879267651.Skill_Desc: Throw a medium net to catch fish.

1879302595.Skill_Desc: You enlist a Herald to carry your Banner of Victory into battle. This banner reduces power costs of those around it.
1879302595.Skill_Name: Call to Arms: Herald of Victory (Lossoth)

1879316163.Skill_Desc: Summons a copper-back frog to keep you company.
1879316163.Collection_Piece_SourceDesc: Available for barter in Eastern Gondor.

1879344579.Skill_Desc: Brings out a moth kite for you to fly!
1879344579.Collection_Piece_SourceDesc: Available through barter during the Spring Festival.

1879357635.Skill_Desc: Journey to the Allegiance Hall: Hall of the King
1879357635.Skill_Name: Journey to the Hall of the King

1879368643.Skill_Desc: Brings out a teacup goat kid to keep you company.
1879368643.Collection_Piece_SourceDesc: Available from Theodore Gorse during the Treasure Bugan event.

1879374531.Skill_Desc: Thanks to your friendship with the Ironfold Dwarves, you're able to quickly return to Járnfast. This skill is easily interrupted.

1879385795.Skill_Desc: Brings out a corrupted craban to keep you company.
1879385795.Collection_Piece_SourceDesc: Available from the Skirmishes -- Ill Omens event.

1879410883.Skill_Desc: A distinguished steed who has seen fit to carry you.
1879410883.Collection_Piece_SourceDesc: Available during the Farmers Faire Festival.

1879411779.Skill_Desc: A wide back-handed smash that may catch multiple enemies with its force.

1879414211.Skill_Desc: A favourite Yule toy.\n\nYou may ride it in most towns and cities.
1879414211.Collection_Piece_SourceDesc: Available from Hobbit Presents as a special Winter Gift.

1879476163.Skill_Desc: Navigate to Halrax in the Shield Isles with nearby fellows.

1879476803.Skill_Desc: Summons an Umbari huorn to accompany you on your travels.
1879476803.Collection_Piece_SourceDesc: Available for barter from the Ledger-keepers Allegiance Rewards Quartermaster in Umbar.

1879485251.Collection_Piece_SourceDesc: Only available from the Whimsical Patron's Luxuriant Coffer.

1879492163.Skill_Desc: Demoralize your foe with petty insults and criticisms.

1879516867.Skill_Desc: Summons a vigilant cobra to watch your back on your adventures.
1879516867.Collection_Piece_SourceDesc: Available in the Kingdoms of Harad Collector's Edition or Ultimate Fan Bundle.
